_comment: Asset manifest for the Godot slice (#631). Every visible object in the current slice is generated from Godot primitives in the scene scripts; no third-party file is committed. This manifest records that decision, the licence facts of every free pack we intend to use, and the paid packs worth buying later. Verified 2026-10-26; the human-readable version with the aesthetic reasoning is docs/godot/ASSETS.md. Version 5 (2026-10-28, #728): addon and asset candidates re-verified for the Godot implementation blueprint, including the one candidate refused on its licence.

rules: No asset enters this repository without a per-pack licence check, an attribution line if required, and a public-repo redistribution check.
Placeholder art must be either generated or explicitly CC0; 'found online' is not a licence.
Commercial 'use inside a game only' licences (Synty and similar) never allow committing the raw files: keep them git-ignored and document how to obtain them.
CC0 packs may be bought and committed; that is why KayKit Complete is the first purchase.

aesthetic_target.camera: 3D diorama, isometric or near-isometric; Disco Elysium framing built with low-poly/voxel art
aesthetic_target.people: 2D portraits for every speaker; 3D bodies only when the tactical layer exists
aesthetic_target.city: voxel-or-chunky low-poly at night, wet surfaces, fog and bloom (Cloudpunk); voxel interiors the player can read at a glance (Shadows of Doubt)
aesthetic_target.narrative: dialogue- and UI-forward, dice-driven action economy (Disco Elysium, Citizen Sleeper)
aesthetic_target.combat: none in the detective slice; isometric turn-based (Shadowrun: Dragonfall) is a later milestone

pipeline: Free CC0 kits replace the primitive geometry in the ward first; nothing is bought until the camera and post-processing are proven.
Blender -> glTF 2.0 for anything 3D; keep source files out of the repo unless the licence covers them.
Voxel route (if Shadows of Doubt is the target): MagicaVoxel -> glb, or godot_voxel for runtime volumes. Do not mix a voxel corridor with a low-poly ward.
Portraits are commissioned or made in-house; no stock pack is recommended for them.
Every file added gets a manifest row before it is committed.
